ifeq ($(uname_S),Linux)
	MALLOC=jemalloc
endif

        CFLAGS+=-funwind-tables

ifeq ($(USE_TCMALLOC),yes)
	MALLOC=tcmalloc

	MALLOC=tcmalloc_minimal
endif

	MALLOC=jemalloc

	MALLOC=libc
endif

ifdef SANITIZER

	MALLOC=libc
	CFLAGS+=-fsanitize=address -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer
	LDFLAGS+=-fsanitize=address
